title: ERCs: the standards apps and wallets share
description: An ERC (Ethereum Request for Comments) is a standard that lets apps on Ethereum, like tokens, NFTs and wallets, speak the same language. Unlike EIPs that change network rules, ERCs need no hard fork. They are in use as soon as wallets and apps adopt them. Explanations are written in Korean.
